method: Conservative growth at a reasonable price (GARP). The screen looks at established, mostly profitable large and mid caps with strong but sustainable revenue growth, reasonable forward P/E and PEG multiples, positive analyst consensus and real upside to the price target. Speculative, pre-profit and very high-beta names are left to the Risk It tab. The top 12 are shown and a ranked bench refills any card you dismiss.
dataNotes: Price, market cap, forward P/E, PEG, TTM revenue growth, consensus rating and average price target come from StockAnalysis.com (S&P Global Market Intelligence) as of the Oct 6, 2026 close. 'n/a' means the figure was not available. Bench: 16 ranked backup candidates (best-first, 'rank' field) from the same screen, used to refill the 12 visible slots when a pick is dismissed; bench figures are from StockAnalysis stock overview pages (Oct 6, 2026 close) and PEG is 'n/a' where it was not captured.

picks.trend: AI data-center demand for HBM/DRAM: Micron says it has contracted the vast majority of its calendar-2027 HBM supply at significantly higher prices and guided FQ1-27 revenue to $61.5B ± $1.5B.
picks.fundamentals: TTM revenue $133.2B with an 80.7% gross margin, $59.0B free cash flow and $68.3B net cash; the stock trades on about 6x forward earnings despite a $1.18T market cap.
risks: Memory is cyclical: new supply could reverse pricing and margins
High volatility (beta 2.23; stock up ~457% over 52 weeks)
